bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls enabling regulated insurers to safely adopt analytics and ML capabilities without fragmenting security posture across deployments.
Established a shared-responsibility operating model that clarified AWS vs. insurer-owned control boundaries, creating a governance pattern reusable across regulated cloud deployments.
Led AWS modernization execution to migrate monolithic policy administration and insurance platform workloads onto cloud infrastructure.
